body.name: Text Uppercaser
body.description: Convert input text to uppercase and return the transformed result.

config.name: Text Uppercaser
config.description: Convert input text to uppercase and return the transformed result.

body.manifest_yaml:
schema_version: '0.3'
name: text-uppercaser
title: Text Uppercaser
description: Convert input text to uppercase and return the transformed result.
version: 0.1.0
targets:
- generic
exec:
  entry: run.py
  runtime: python311
  runner: e2b
  command: python run.py
  inputs:
  - name: text
    kind: scalar
    type: string
    required: true
    label: Input text
  outputs:
  - name: uppercased
    kind: scalar
    type: string
    required: true
    label: Uppercased text
trigger:
  type: manual
example_input:
  text: Hello, Workeros!
